title.narrative: Deepening Impacts and Learning Opportunities for Climate Resilience in Bungoma County

description.narrative: Since 2018, Anglican Development Services Western (ADS-W), in partnership with Christian Aid, has been implementing climate change initiatives across Western Kenya counties (Kakamega, Vihiga, Bungoma, Nandi and Trans-Nzoia). The latest intervention was implemented in Bungoma County, Bumula Sub-County with a particular focus on smallholder farmers under the project title Strengthening Climate Adaptation, Resilience, Livelihoods, and Gender Inclusion in Kisumu and Bungoma Counties through Inclusive Climate Finance and Climate-Smart Practices. The collaboration has evolved into a robust platform for promoting community-level climate adaptation through inclusive climate finance, the adoption of climate-smart practices, and the strengthening of local climate governance structures. The ongoing project, Strengthening Climate Adaptation, Resilience, Livelihoods, and Gender Inclusion, aimed to improve the adaptive capacities of vulnerable communities while aligning with Kenya’s devolved climate finance frameworks and policies, such as the Bungoma County Climate Change Act (2022) and the Bungoma County Climate Change Action Plan. Significant achievements to date include the establishment and capacity building of Ward Climate Change Planning Committees (WCCPCs)—the core local structures mandated to plan and oversee climate actions; support to 500 local farmer producers to adopt climate-smart agricultural practices, diversify their livelihoods, and implement green energy technologies; and improved access to localized climate information, enhancing community-level planning and preparedness. These gains demonstrate the potential of community-led, policy-anchored approaches in building resilience to climate change at the grassroots level. As climate risks grow in scale and complexity, there is an increasing need to consolidate these outcomes, scale successful models, and generate actionable learning to inform adaptive management and evidence-based policy implementation. This proposed project by ADSW is aimed at strengthening the capacity of local institutions in preparing themselves for the changing situations and integrating them into various government (County and National) policy frames; Scale proven models embedded within the Bungoma County Climate Change Action Plan and Build knowledge base that supports continuous learning through innovations and advocacy. These will help the project to promote institutional and technical capacity building within key agencies and among community associations/groups for demand-responsive services needed to better adapt and govern their existing systems. Moreover, the emerging ecosystem of supportive policies, multi-stakeholder networks, and devolved governance frameworks in Bungoma provides ground to strengthen institutional capacities, unlock climate finance flows, and mainstream resilience into sustainable development planning.
